name: Thrust bearing 51104 (20 x 35 x 10)
source: ISO 104 / SKF 51104 dimensions (bore 20 mm, OD 35 mm, 10 mm thick)
notes: Axial (thrust) ball bearing, 20 mm bore, 35 mm outside diameter, 10 mm tall, axis along z. Carries the weight of the arm's turntable on a base plate; the servo horn spins above it.
